HtmlBodyPart.Html:
What you should do next:

  • Ask your administrator to make sure you been assigned with the correct access permissions.
  • Make sure you open in a new browser and you are login on your DfE sign in account
  • visit this page again

Welcome to a test Gov UK Web Application. The propose of this application is to test the Barracuda SaaS WAF. 

Features of the application include:

  • DfE sign in managing user authentication and authorization 
  • Blob storage file upload
  • Form data collection using GDS Components
  • Data validations
  • User input storage 
  • Shared content across pages
  • Session management across pages
  • JavaScript and jQuery loaded for user interaction

The web application is powered by Orchard Core CMS v3.0.1 and build using .NET 10 and the Gov UK Frontend v6.3.0 framework.
